instruction.text: Spell the word to find out what it means.
instruction.sound: ssml: Spell the word to find out what it means. <break time='500ms'/> Wants.

feedback.finish: Wants are things you do not really need to survive but that you may like to have.

instruction.text: Find and select the image that matches the want.

atoms.a: Olivia wants a new bike for her birthday.
Rafaela would like to eat a doughnut for dessert.
Freya wants to have another dress for herself, even though she has a wardrobe that is full of them at home.
Gabriel wants another toy to complete his dinosaur collection.

instruction.text: Listen to both examples and choose the want.

b.sound: Priscilla wishes for a pair of roller-skates for Christmas.
It gets very cold in Winter, so Priscilla has to buy a warm jacket.

feedback.correct: It might be nice to have new roller-skates, but Priscilla doesn’t need them.
feedback.wrong: Cold weather can be very dangerous, so Priscilla needs warm clothes to stay safe.

instruction.text: Listen to both examples and choose the want.

b.sound: Dominic would like to read another book next week because he enjoys reading so much.
After a long day at school, Dominic is very hungry and has to eat.

feedback.correct: Reading is fun, but it is only something Dominic wants to do.
feedback.wrong: Dominic needs to eat, otherwise his health may suffer.

instruction.text: Listen to both examples and choose the want.

b.sound: Maya would like to play a new computer game, but her parents won’t buy it for her.
Maya’s family are looking for a new house, as they have to move out of their old one.

feedback.correct: Maya’s wellbeing won’t suffer without her new computer game, so it is a want.
feedback.wrong: Shelter is important to have a place to sleep and be safe, so the family need a house.
